name: Fushigi na Tabi
summary: Fushigi na Tabi is a first-person fantasy adventure game. After a nuclear armageddon destroys the Earth, the player awakens alone in a strange otherworld of grassland and rock, and sets out to find a way home. Illustrated first-person scenes are paired with a compass, on-screen status readouts and a verb-command parser, and the inhabitants are lethal: a red-cloaked creature can turn the player to stone with a muttered spell. It began life as a prize-winning entry in an amateur game-programming contest.
